WITH irs_data AS (
    SELECT 
        d.devregistry AS device_id,
        d.makername AS manufacturer,
        d.modnum AS model_number,
        t.pollratehz AS polling_rate,
        t.inplagms AS input_lag,
        t.resptimems AS response_time,
        ROUND(CAST((t.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (t.inplagms + t.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0 AS numeric), 2) AS irs
    FROM testsessions t
    JOIN deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
    WHERE t.devscope IN ('Keyboard', 'Mouse')
    AND ROUND(CAST((t.pollratehz::numeric / 100.0) * (1.0 - (t.inplagms + t.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0 AS numeric), 2) > 8.0
),
avg_irs AS (
    SELECT manufacturer, AVG(irs) AS avg_irs
    FROM irs_data
    GROUP BY manufacturer
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        i.device_id,

        i.model_number,
        i.polling_rate,
        i.input_lag,
        i.response_time,
        i.irs,
        a.avg_irs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.manufacturer ORDER BY i.irs DESC) AS rn
    FROM irs_data i

)
SELECT

    model_number,
    polling_rate,
    input_lag,
    response_time,
    irs,
    ROUND(CAST(avg_irs AS numeric), 2) AS avg_irs,
